changelog:
- Initial release of the symmetric Bollinger band mean-reversion strategy for the 4h timeframe.
- Trades both long and short on 2σ band touches, confirmed by RSI and restricted to ADX < 25 (range regime).
- Features a tight multi-tier ROI ladder and -2% stop; no trailing stop.
- Validated results: +8.77% profit at 65.5% win rate across BTC/ETH/SOL/DOGE (162 days, 84 trades).
- Designed for majors; not recommended for meme/low-cap pairs. 
- Pairs with donchian-strong-regime for complete regime coverage.
summary: Use when writing a symmetric Bollinger-band mean-reversion strategy on the 4h timeframe — anything described as BB reverter, range trader, chop strategy, ADX...
